_comment: Staged CI enforcement (2026-07-25) for the Telegram delivery gateway migration. This repo is a single file (index.js), so unlike flexai-saas's per-file allowlist, LEGACY (pending-migration) growth is tracked by a simple call-site COUNT of `await sendTelegram(` / `await sendTelegramWithId(` calls, EXCLUDING any call site explicitly marked as a named exception (see telegram-direct-send-exceptions.json -- those are checked separately, for an exact 1:1 match, not folded into this count). The count must never INCREASE from this baseline -- it should only go DOWN as senders migrate one at a time. A new direct sendTelegram call site (growth) fails the deploy check; migrating an existing one off direct-send requires lowering this baseline deliberately in the same commit, as proof the reduction was intentional and reviewed, not accidental.
